lessons.title: State a policy's current scope
lessons.learn: Describe what a policy currently covers and what remains planned.

lessons.title: Compare competing proposals
lessons.learn: Compare two proposals using the same criteria and state the trade-off.

grammar.title: parallel evaluation
grammar.pattern: 方案 A ...；方案 B ...；需要权衡 ...
grammar.explain: Compare cost, access or timing consistently, then name the trade-off.

examples.t: 方案乙能服务更多居民，不过需要更多时间。
examples.r: fāng àn yǐ néng fú wù gèng duō jū mín，bú guò xū yào gèng duō shí jiān。

examples.t: 选择时要同时考虑成本和覆盖范围。

lessons.title: Paraphrase two positions
lessons.learn: Summarise each position neutrally and ask both parties to confirm.

grammar.title: neutral paraphrase
grammar.pattern: 一方认为 ...；另一方希望 ...；这样概括准确吗？
grammar.explain: Describe the positions without adding motives, then make the summary a check.

examples.t: 一方认为应该先确定时间表。
examples.r: yì fāng rèn wéi yīng gāi xiān què dìng shí jiān biǎo。
examples.en: One side thinks the schedule should be set first.

examples.t: 另一方希望先说明评估标准。
examples.r: lìng yì fāng xī wàng xiān shuō míng píng gū biāo zhǔn。
examples.en: The other side would like the evaluation criteria explained first.

examples.t: 这样概括双方的立场准确吗？
examples.r: zhè yàng gài kuò shuāng fāng de lì chǎng zhǔn què ma？
examples.en: Does this summary accurately describe both positions?

mistakes.right: 一方重视时间表，另一方希望先明确标准。
mistakes.why: Describe the stated positions rather than inferring motivation.

dialogue.t: 一方认为应该先确定时间表。
dialogue.r: yì fāng rèn wéi yīng gāi xiān què dìng shí jiān biǎo。

culture.text: Chinese New Year and other festivals are celebrated in varied ways by families and communities. Food, visits and public events differ by region, religion, migration history and personal choice. A description should name its source or community rather than turn one family's practice into a rule for everyone. At B2+, a recommendation includes criteria and a review point. Mediation should report what each party said, not infer a motive that the record cannot establish.

reading.text: 社区准备了一场节日活动。组织者公布了时间和地点，也说明参加活动完全自愿。居民提出了几个建议，团队把建议分类后再决定哪些可以实行。 委员会用同一标准比较了两个方案。一个成本较低，另一个服务范围较广。会议决定先进行试点，并在三个月后复查结果。
reading.gloss: The community prepared a festival event. Organisers announced the time and place and clarified that attendance was voluntary. Residents offered several suggestions; the team grouped them before deciding which could be implemented. The committee compared two plans using the same criterion. One cost less; the other served a wider area. The meeting decided to begin with a pilot and review the results after three months.

listening.script:
居民：能不能把活动时间改晚一点？
组织者：可以讨论，不过要先确认场地。
居民：我也可以帮忙联系邻居。
组织者：谢谢，我们把分工写清楚。
编辑：会议是不是否定了第二个方案？
协调员：没有，只是先试行第一个阶段。
编辑：我会把这个区别写清楚。
listening.gloss: Resident: Could the event start a little later? Organiser: We can discuss it, but first we need to confirm the venue. Resident: I can also contact neighbours. Organiser: Thank you; let's make the task assignments clear. Editor: Did the meeting reject the second proposal? Coordinator: No; it is starting with the first stage as a trial. Editor: I will make that distinction clear.
